levels.title: The festival’s missing room
levels.word: capacity · accommodate · flexible · contingency · unforeseen · revise
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A neighborhood festival expects eighty people, but its main room has a capacity of sixty. The organizers cannot accommodate everyone safely by simply moving chairs closer together. A successful invitation creates a practical duty to plan for the people who accept it.
paragraphs.zh: 一场社区节庆预计有八十人参加，但主厅容量只有六十人。组织者不能仅靠把椅子挪近一点，就安全容纳所有人。邀请成功，也意味着必须认真安排前来的人。

paragraphs.en: The team designs a flexible timetable with repeated sessions. It also keeps a contingency plan for an unforeseen problem, such as a room becoming unavailable. The backup is specific enough to use: it names another space, a contact person, and a way to notify guests.
paragraphs.zh: 团队设计了可灵活调整的时间表，重复举行部分场次，并为房间突然不能使用等意外情况准备应变方案。备用计划具体到可以执行：写明另一处空间、联系人和通知来宾的方式。

paragraphs.en: When a speaker cancels, the organizers revise the order of events instead of pretending nothing has changed. Guests receive one clear update, rather than several conflicting messages. Flexibility is useful when changes remain understandable to the people affected by them.
paragraphs.zh: 一位讲者取消行程后，组织者修改活动顺序，而不假装一切未变。来宾收到一条清晰更新，而非几条相互矛盾的消息。当受影响的人能够理解变动时，灵活性才有实际价值。

article.title: Where did the missing plastic go?

paragraphs.en: Volunteers collect plastic from a riverbank every month. After a storm, the visible amount falls, but this does not necessarily mean the waste has disappeared. Some pieces disperse downstream, while others accumulate behind fallen branches. A count at one location shows only part of the movement.
paragraphs.zh: 志愿者每月清理河岸塑料。暴风雨后，可见塑料减少，但不一定意味着垃圾消失了。有些碎片向下游散布，另一些则堆积在倒下的树枝后。一处地点的统计，只呈现移动过程的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Sunlight and wear can cause a large item to fragment into smaller pieces. Those pieces may persist even when they become difficult to see. A filter can catch some particles, but the team does not assume that making water look clear removes every residue.
paragraphs.zh: 日晒和磨损可能使大件物体破碎成较小碎片。即使变得难以看见，这些碎片仍可能持续存在。过滤器可以截留一些颗粒，但团队没有假定让水看上去清澈，就能清除所有残留物。

paragraphs.en: The volunteers also test a material designed to absorb an oily spill. They weigh it before and after use and arrange safe disposal, because moving contamination from water into another material is not the same as making it vanish. The project follows where unwanted matter goes rather than judging success only by appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 志愿者也测试了一种用于吸收泄漏油污的材料。他们在使用前后称重，并安排安全处理，因为将污染物从水中转移到另一种材料里，不等于让它凭空消失。项目追踪不需要的物质去了哪里，而不是只凭外观判断成功。

levels.title: A bowl beneath the floor
levels.word: artifact · excavate · date · trace · intact · reconstruct
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: During repairs, workers find an old bowl below a floor. A nearby museum treats it as an artifact, but the object alone does not tell the whole story. Specialists want to excavate the surrounding area carefully before anyone removes more material.
paragraphs.zh: 维修期间，工人在地板下发现一个旧碗。附近博物馆将其视为人工遗存，但物品本身并不能说明全部历史。专家希望在继续移走材料前，先仔细发掘周边区域。

paragraphs.en: The bowl is nearly intact, and a small trace of food remains inside it. The team records its position and compares nearby materials to help date the find. The date of a neighboring object is useful evidence, but is not automatically the exact age of the bowl.
paragraphs.zh: 碗几乎完整，内部还留有少量食物痕迹。团队记录其位置，并比较附近材料以帮助判断年代。邻近物品的年代是有用证据，但不自动等于碗的确切年龄。

paragraphs.en: In the exhibition, the museum uses drawings to reconstruct a possible room around the bowl. It marks which details come from evidence and which are reasonable guesses. A vivid reconstruction can support understanding while still leaving space for another explanation when new evidence appears.
paragraphs.zh: 在展览中，博物馆用图画重建碗周围可能存在的房间，并标明哪些细节来自证据，哪些是合理推测。生动重建有助理解，同时仍应为新证据出现后的其他解释留出空间。

paragraphs.en: After several weeks of late-night study, Emi notices fatigue even on easy tasks. She has increased her hours without asking whether the pace is sustainable. Finishing one long evening does not show that the same schedule can work for a whole term.
paragraphs.zh: 连续几周熬夜学习后，惠美发现自己做简单任务也会疲劳。她增加了时长，却没问这种节奏能否持续。完成一个漫长夜晚，并不代表同样的安排适合整个学期。

paragraphs.en: She changes to shorter sessions and leaves time to replenish her attention between them. The plan includes moderate goals on busy days instead of an all-or-nothing rule. This is a practical scheduling choice, not a promise that everyone needs the same routine.
paragraphs.zh: 她改为较短的学习时段，并在其间留时间恢复注意力。忙碌日子的目标适度，而非非全有即全无的规则。这是实用的时间安排选择，不是说每个人都需要同一种日程。

paragraphs.en: When an unexpected obligation interrupts a day, Emi returns to the plan the next morning. She thinks of resilience as the ability to adjust and continue, rather than never encountering difficulty. Her record shows what she did over time; one missed day no longer erases the rest of the story.
paragraphs.zh: 当突如其来的义务打乱一天时，惠美第二天早晨再回到计划。她把韧性理解为调整并继续的能力，而非从不遇到困难。记录展示的是一段时间内做过的事；错过一天不再抹去其他全部努力。

article.title: A clever idea needs a guardrail

paragraphs.en: A company introduces an innovation that predicts when shared bicycles need repair. Early tests save staff time, but the tool also records more location details than the repair task requires. An improvement in one part of a service can create an unintended problem elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 一家公司推出预测共享自行车何时需要维修的新技术。早期测试节省了员工时间，但工具也记录了超出维修任务所需的位置细节。服务某一部分的改进，可能在别处引发未预期的问题。

paragraphs.en: The city considers a regulation limiting what can be collected and how long it can be kept. The company adds a safeguard that removes unnecessary detail before records are stored. These steps need to be checked in practice, rather than assumed effective because they sound reassuring.
paragraphs.zh: 城市考虑制定规则，限制可以收集什么以及保留多久。公司增加保护措施，在保存记录前删除不必要细节。这些步骤需要实际核验，而不能因听起来让人安心，就假定有效。

paragraphs.en: The team faces a dilemma when a rare repair problem seems easier to investigate with more detailed data. Independent oversight helps examine whether the extra collection is proportionate to the need. The goal is to keep useful learning possible while making limits and responsibility clear.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个罕见维修问题似乎需要更详细数据才容易调查时，团队面临两难。独立监督帮助审查额外收集是否与需要相称。目标是在保留有益学习的同时，使界限与责任清晰。

article.title: The result that did not repeat

paragraphs.en: A research group announces a striking result from a small study. Before changing practice, other researchers scrutinize the methods and ask a second team to corroborate the finding. Agreement matters more when it comes from a genuinely separate check rather than repeated use of the same records.
paragraphs.zh: 一个研究组宣布小型研究得到了引人注目的结果。在改变实践前，其他研究者仔细审查方法，并请第二个团队印证结果。独立核查得出的相符结果，比反复使用同一批记录更有意义。

paragraphs.en: The second study finds a smaller effect and leaves several questions unresolved. The original group now describes its explanation as tentative. It still considers parts of the evidence compelling, but acknowledges that a strong-looking result can be narrower than its first headline suggests.
paragraphs.zh: 第二项研究发现的效应较小，仍留下几个未解决问题。原研究组现在将其解释描述为暂定。它仍认为部分证据有说服力，但承认看似强劲的结果，适用范围可能比最初标题所暗示的更窄。

paragraphs.en: One critic tries to refute the entire account; another argues for a more limited conclusion. The authors concede that the initial wording was too broad and publish a correction. Revising a claim in response to evidence can improve an explanation rather than erase all value in the earlier work.
paragraphs.zh: 一位批评者试图驳倒整个解释，另一位则主张得出更有限的结论。作者承认最初措辞过宽，并发表更正。根据证据修订论断，可以改进解释，而不必抹去此前工作的全部价值。

article.title: A garden that can take the rain

paragraphs.en: A neighborhood wants a more resilient response to repeated street flooding. Residents propose a rain garden to help alleviate runoff, but the available site is small. The idea must be examined alongside drainage, maintenance, and the needs of people who use the street every day.
paragraphs.zh: 一个社区希望以更有韧性的方式应对反复出现的街道积水。居民提议建雨水花园，帮助缓解径流，但可用场地很小。这个想法需要与排水、养护及日常使用街道者的需求一起考察。

paragraphs.en: Engineers, shop owners, and residents collaborate on a trial design. They choose a proportionate first step rather than promising to eliminate every flood. The trial includes a clear maintenance plan, because a garden that nobody can look after is unlikely to remain useful.
paragraphs.zh: 工程师、店主和居民协作设计试点方案。他们选择与问题程度相称的第一步，而不承诺消除所有积水。试点包含清晰养护计划，因为无人能照料的花园不太可能长期有用。

paragraphs.en: After several storms, the group meets to evaluate both the water measurements and everyday experience. The result suggests the plan is viable in this location, though it does not solve every drainage problem. They record what worked, what remains uncertain, and what the next test should ask. The next decision begins with evidence gathered from the last one.
paragraphs.zh: 几场暴风雨后，小组会面评估水量测量与日常体验。结果表明计划在这里可行，但不能解决所有排水问题。他们记录哪些有效、哪些仍不确定，以及下次测试应回答什么。下一次决定从上一次收集的证据开始。
